Mine & build

Hold the left mouse button to break a block. Right-click to place or use the item in your hand. A pickaxe is needed for ore. Use tools made of stronger materials to mine faster.

Craft & survive

Start with wood. Open your inventory and use the recipe book to craft planks, sticks, and a crafting table. Place the table and right-click it for a 3 × 3 grid. Build a shelter before night.

A living world

Find villages, trade with villagers, farm crops, cook in a furnace, and sleep in a bed. Fill a bucket at water. Right-click a portal to change dimensions. Hostile creatures appear at night.

Desktop: click the world to capture your mouse. Escape releases it. On touch screens, drag the right side to look. This is a playable subset of Minecraft, with original generated textures.
